name: Made in Abyss
description: Located in the center of a remote island, the Abyss is the last unexplored region, a huge and treacherous fathomless hole inhabited by strange creatures where only the bravest adventurers descend in search of ancient relics. In the upper levels of the Abyss, Riko, a girl who dreams of becoming an explorer, stumbles upon a mysterious little boy.

videos.title: Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun Mini Anime
videos.overview: Short focusing on Prushka included with the first volume of the Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun Blu-ray/DVD box set.

videos.title: The City of the Great Pit
videos.overview: While exploring the Abyss, Riko comes across something she has never seen before. How does this new discovery impact her?

videos.title: Resurrection Festival
videos.overview: Riko and Reg find out more about their past but the question still remains, who or what exactly is Reg?

videos.title: Departure
videos.overview: Reg goes on his first cave raid! Meanwhile, Riko makes preparations to go into the abyss to find her mother.

videos.title: The Edge of the Abyss
videos.overview: Riko and Reg start their adventure into the Abyss, while there they run into an unexpected familiar face.

videos.title: Incinerator
videos.overview: Riko and Reg descend into the Forest of Temptation. What new dangers will they find laying in wait for them there?

videos.title: Seeker Camp
videos.overview: Reg and Riko make it to the Seeker Camp where they meet Ozen the Immovable, the person who saved Riko all those years ago. But there is more to Ozen than meets the eye.

videos.title: The Unmovable Sovereign
videos.overview: Ozen reveals more about the Abyss as well as the truth behind Riko's origins. What will happen when Ozen shows her true colors?

videos.title: Survival Training
videos.overview: Ozen tasks Riko and Reg to survive alone outside the Seeker Camp. Do they come out alive and unscathed? Or does the Abyss have a dirty trick up its sleeve?

videos.title: The Great Fault
videos.overview: Reg and Riko continue their descent after they leave Ozen's Seeker Camp. Riko's mettle is tested as Reg passes out and she has to fend for herself.

videos.title: Poison and the Curse
videos.overview: Reg and Riko run into trouble deep in the fourth layer where they meet an interesting creature, but are they friend or foe?

videos.title: Nanachi
videos.overview: Nanachi sends Reg on a mission to find certain items that could possibly save Riko. Meanwhile, Nanachi reveals a little more about themself.

videos.title: The True Nature of the Curse
videos.overview: Nanachi shows Reg the truth about the Abyss. Meanwhile, Riko is still recovering from her injuries when she has a strange dream.

videos.title: The Challengers
videos.overview: Nanachi and Mitty's past is revealed. How did they become what they are and who is responsible for it? Meanwhile, Riko is on the mend after her injuries.

videos.title: The Compass Pointed to the Darkness
videos.overview: An old man speaks of a golden city that lies within a devouring abyss somewhere in uncharted waters. One explorer may be the key to finding both.

videos.title: Capital of the Unreturned
videos.overview: Riko, Reg and Nanachi take their first steps into the sixth layer. Both wonders and dangers await the trio, but they are unaware they are being watched.

videos.title: Village of the Hollows
videos.overview: Riko couldn’t have known the consequences of her words, but she sealed the villager’s fate as soon as she acknowledged Meinya was priceless. The Balancing has begun…

videos.title: Friend
videos.overview: Faputa and Reg once knew each other, but Reg cannot remember her at all now. Meanwhile, Nanachi is stunned by news so unexpected that it should be impossible to believe.

videos.title: Concealment
videos.overview: Some say there’s a secret hidden deep within the dark cave at the edge of the village. Villagers don’t investigate and stay far away, but Riko isn’t a villager.

videos.title: The Luring
videos.overview: The villagers must lure abyssal fauna into the village to hunt them. But when one creature proves too much to handle, Riko needs to help the villagers defend their home.

videos.title: The Cradle of Desire
videos.overview: What happened to the expedition? The truth is far more tragic and horrifying than anyone could have imagined.

videos.title: The Form the Wish Takes
videos.overview: They had their reasons for descending into that infernal pit. They found damnation and salvation in equal measure.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Faputa can help Reg save Nanachi, but everything has a price. In exchange, Reg must help her enter the village.

videos.title: All That You Gather
videos.overview: The reckoning comes, but Reg is too kind and foolish to be a bystander.

videos.title: Value
videos.overview: The village’s membrane has been breached, and through the gap floods chaos itself. But as attackers enter from without, aid comes from within.

videos.title: Gold
videos.overview: In the end, everything comes full circle.
